### Predict BGC of state hex grids

This predicts each point in a state hexgrid (data saved from 0_climr_attribution). The scripts then dissolve the hexgrid to reduce size and remove (decrumb) small BGC polygons to further simplify.

Save each state BGC as a .gpkg file. This takes about 1.5 hours to run through 9 western states.

```{r original function to predict BGC of each state}
#load("./outputs/USAv12_62nosmote_VAR_SubZone_ranger.Rdata")
# bring in grid data with climate attributes

predict_state_hex <- function(region){
# Z1 <- fread(paste0("./inputs/grids/", region, "_400m_HexPts_Normal_1961_1990MSY.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE,  data.table = FALSE) %>% 
#   addVars() %>% 
#   filter_all(all_vars(. > -9999)) %>% 
#   dplyr::rename(ID = id)
Z1 <- readRDS(paste0("./inputs/grids/", region, "_400m_HexPts_Normal_1961_1990SY.rds")) %>% 
  filter_all(all_vars(. > -9999))


grid.info <- Z1 %>% dplyr::select(id, lat, lon, elev)
grid.dat <-  Z1 %>%  select(id, model_vars$rowname)
grid.dat$id <- as.integer(grid.dat$id)
###Predict
grid.pred <- predict(BGCmodel, grid.dat) #%>% mutate(BGC.pred = as.character(.pred_class))
#grid.pred <- grid.pred %>% mutate(BGC.pred = as.character(.pred_class))
grid.info <- grid.info %>% filter(grid.info$id %in% grid.dat$id)
grid.pred <- cbind(grid.info, grid.pred) %>% dplyr::rename(BGC.pred = .pred_class)
grid.pred$BGC <-
  fct_na_value_to_level(as.factor(grid.pred$BGC.pred) , level = "(None)")
grid.pred <- grid.pred %>%  dplyr::select(id, BGC)#"Longitude","Latitude", "Elevation", "Zone")]
grid.pred$id <- as.character(grid.pred$id)
fwrite(grid.pred, paste0("./outputs/grid_preds/", region,"_predicted_hexpts.csv"))

### joint to hexpoly grid
hexpoly <- st_read(dsn = paste0("./inputs/hex_shapes/", region, "_bgc_hex400.gpkg"))#, layer = "USA_bgc_hex_800m")
hexpoly$hex_id <- as.character(hexpoly$hex_id)
hexZone <- left_join(hexpoly, grid.pred, by = c("hex_id" = "id"))# %>% st_transform(3005) %>% st_cast()
temp <- hexZone %>% select(BGC, geom)
temp2 <- st_zm(temp, drop=T, what='ZM') 

###Dissolve 
temp3 <- hexZone
temp3$BGC <- droplevels(temp3$BGC)
temp3 <-  st_as_sf(temp3)# 
st_precision(temp3) <- .5 
temp3$BGC <- 
  fct_na_value_to_level(as.factor(temp3$BGC), level = "(None)")#forcats::fct_explicit_na(temp3$BGC,na_level = "(None)")

temp3 <- temp3[,c("BGC","geom")]#,"Elevation"
t2 <- aggregate(temp3[,-1], by = list(temp3$BGC), do_union = T, FUN = mean) %>% rename(BGC = Group.1)
wna_boundary = st_read("./inputs/spatial_files/WNA_StateProv_Boundaries.gpkg") %>% 
  st_as_sf() %>% filter(State %in% region) %>%
  st_transform( crs = st_crs(3005)) %>%
  st_buffer(., dist = 0)

t2 <- st_zm(t2, drop=T, what='ZM') %>% 
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(3005))  %>% 
  st_buffer(0)
t2 <- st_intersection(t2, wna_boundary)

# st_write(t2, dsn = paste0("./outputs/", region, "_SubZoneMap_hex400_dissolved_19Apr2024.gpkg"), driver = "GPKG", delete_dsn = TRUE)

t2a <- st_cast(t2, "MULTIPOLYGON") %>% st_cast("POLYGON")
t2a <- t2a %>%
  mutate(Area = st_area(.)) %>%
  mutate(id = seq_along(BGC))

### decrumb polygons
require (units)
size <- 600000
size <- set_units(size, "m^2")
tSmall <- t2a[t2a$Area <= size,]
t2a$BGC <- as.character(t2a$BGC)

require(doParallel)
coreNum <- as.numeric(detectCores()-1)
coreNo <- makeCluster(coreNum)
registerDoParallel(coreNo, cores = coreNum)

###loop through each polygon < size, determine intersects, and assign to BGC with most edge touching
###all the built in functions Kiri found only dealt with holes in the middle of polygons

new <- foreach(i = 1:length(tSmall$id), .combine = rbind, .packages = c("foreach","sf")) %dopar% {
  id <- tSmall$id[i]
  nbrs <- st_intersects(tSmall[i,],t2a)[[1]]
  nbrs <- nbrs[!nbrs %in% id]
  if(length(nbrs) == 0){return(NULL)}
  lines <- st_intersection(t2a[id,],t2a[nbrs,])
  lines <- st_cast(lines)
  l.len <- st_length(lines)
  names(l.len) <- lines$BGC.1
  zn <- names(l.len)[l.len == max(l.len)][1]
  newDat <- t2a[id,]
  newDat$BGC <- zn
  newDat
}

stopCluster(coreNo)
gc()

temp <- t2a[!t2a$id %in% new$id,]
t2a <- rbind(temp, new) %>%
  mutate(BGC = as.factor(BGC))
# ###now have to combine crumbs with existing large polygons
temp2 <- t2a
temp2 <- st_make_valid(temp2)
st_precision(temp2) <- 2
t3 <- temp2 %>%  st_buffer(dist = 0) %>% #filter(!id == "2741") %>% 
  group_by(BGC) %>%
  summarise(geom = sf::st_union(geometry)) %>%
  ungroup()

t3 <- st_zm(t3, drop=T, what='ZM')
st_write(t3, dsn = paste0("./state_BGCmaps/", region, "_BGC_9Mar2026_decrumbed_new.gpkg"), driver = "GPKG",delete_dsn = TRUE)
gc()
}

```

## This one works pretty good but the output has geometry problems that need to be solved in script
```{r fixed terra version}
#region  = "MT"
predict_state_hex <- function(region){

  library(sf)
  library(dplyr)
  library(forcats)
  library(data.table)
  library(doParallel)
  library(tictoc)
  library(terra)

  message("Loading grid…")
  Z1 <- readRDS(paste0("./inputs/grids/", region, "_400m_HexPts_Normal_1961_1990SY.rds")) %>%
    filter_all(all_vars(. > -9999))

  grid.info <- Z1 %>% select(id, lat, lon, elev)
  grid.dat  <- Z1 %>% select(id, model_vars$rowname)
  grid.dat$id <- as.integer(grid.dat$id)

  message("Predicting BGC classes…")
  tic()
  grid.pred <- predict(BGCmodel, grid.dat)
  grid.pred <- cbind(grid.info, grid.pred) %>%
    rename(BGC.pred = .pred_class)

  grid.pred$BGC <- fct_na_value_to_level(as.factor(grid.pred$BGC.pred), "(None)")
  grid.pred <- grid.pred %>% select(id, BGC)
  grid.pred$id <- as.character(grid.pred$id)

  fwrite(grid.pred, paste0("./outputs/grid_preds/", region,"_predicted_hexpts.csv"))
  toc()

  message("Joining predictions to hex grid…")
  tic()
  hexpoly <- st_read(paste0("./inputs/hex_shapes/", region, "_bgc_hex400.gpkg"))
  hexpoly$hex_id <- as.character(hexpoly$hex_id)

  hexZone <- left_join(hexpoly, grid.pred, by = c("hex_id" = "id"))
  hexZone <- st_make_valid(hexZone)
    hexZone <- st_zm(hexZone, drop = TRUE)
st_precision(hexZone) <- .5
  hexZone$BGC <- fct_na_value_to_level(as.factor(hexZone$BGC), "(None)")
  toc()

  # --- HEX-LEVEL DECRUMBING ---------------------------------------------

  message("Computing connected components (hex-level)…")
  tic()
# hex_clean <- st_make_valid(hexZone)
#  hex_clean <- st_zm(hex_clean, drop = TRUE)
library(sf)
library(igraph)
library(dplyr)
# compute adjacency (touching hexes) 
  hex_cc <- hexZone %>% group_by(BGC) %>% group_modify(~{
  
  nb <- st_touches(.x)
  g  <- graph_from_adj_list(nb)
  
  .x$patch <- components(g)$membership
  .x
})
#### Raster based approach works for all by Montana)
# v <- vect(hex_clean)
# v$BGC_int <- as.integer(as.factor(v$BGC))
# 
# # Build a raster template from hex centroids
# cent <- st_centroid(hexZone)
# cent_v <- vect(cent)
# 
# # Create raster with one cell per hex
# r <- rast(cent_v, resolution = 100)   # 400 m hex spacing
# crs(r) <- crs(v)
# 
# 
#   # rasterize BGC classes
#   r_bgc <- rasterize(v, r, field = "BGC_int")
#   #r_bgc[is.na(r_bgc)] <- 0
# 
#   # connected components (patches) on raster
#   r_cc <- terra::patches(r_bgc, directions = 8)
# plot(r_cc)
  # extract patch IDs back to hex polygons
  # patch_vals <- terra::extract(r_cc, v, fun = "first")

  # 
  # patch_vals_unique <- patch_vals |>
  # dplyr::group_by(ID) |>
  # dplyr::summarise(patch = dplyr::first(patches))

  #  patch_vals <- patch_vals  %>% distinct
  hex_sf <- st_as_sf(hex_cc)
  hex_sf <- st_make_valid(hex_sf)
st_precision(hex_sf) <- 2
  #hex_sf$patch <- patch_vals$patch
  toc()

  message("Identifying crumbs (< 10 hexes per patch)…")
  tic()
  patch_sizes <- hex_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    count(BGC, patch, name = "n_hex")

  hex_sf <- hex_sf %>%
    left_join(patch_sizes, by = c("BGC", "patch"))

  crumbs <- hex_sf %>% filter(n_hex < 10)
  cores  <- hex_sf %>% filter(n_hex >= 10)
  toc()

  message("Precomputing neighbors for crumbs…")
  tic()
  crumbs <- st_make_valid(crumbs)
  cores  <- st_make_valid(cores)
  crumbs <- st_zm(crumbs, drop = TRUE)
  cores  <- st_zm(cores, drop = TRUE)

  nbr_list <- st_touches(crumbs, cores)

  crumbs_bound <- st_boundary(crumbs)
  cores_bound  <- st_boundary(cores)
  toc()

  message("Reassigning crumbs to neighboring BGCs…")
  tic()
  coreNum <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
  cl <- makeCluster(coreNum)
  registerDoParallel(cl)

  reassigned <- foreach(i = seq_len(nrow(crumbs)), .combine = rbind,
                        .packages = c("sf", "dplyr")) %dopar% {

    nbr_idx <- nbr_list[[i]]
    if (length(nbr_idx) == 0) return(NULL)

    shared <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(st_intersection(crumbs_bound[i], cores_bound[nbr_idx, ])),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(shared) || length(shared) == 0) return(NULL)

    l.len <- st_length(shared)
    names(l.len) <- cores$BGC[nbr_idx]

    new_bgc <- names(l.len)[which.max(l.len)]
    out <- crumbs[i, ]
    out$BGC <- new_bgc
    out
  }

  stopCluster(cl)
  gc()
  toc()

  message("Rebuilding hex grid after decrumbing…")
  tic()
  if (!is.null(reassigned) && nrow(reassigned) > 0) {
    reassigned_ids <- reassigned$hex_id
    hex_final <- bind_rows(
      cores,
      reassigned,
      crumbs %>% filter(!hex_id %in% reassigned_ids)
    )
  } else {
    hex_final <- hex_sf
    st_precision(hex_final) <- 2
  }
  hex_final$BGC <- as.factor(hex_final$BGC)
  toc()
  
  st_crs(hex_final) <- st_crs(3005)
  hex_final <- st_transform(hex_final, 5070)
  out_path <- paste0("./state_BGCmaps/", region, "_BGC_10Mar2026_5070.gpkg")
st_write(hex_final, out_path, delete_dsn = TRUE)
  # --- FINAL DISSOLVE + OPTIONAL CLIP -----------------------------------

  message("Final dissolve by BGC (terra)…")
  tic()
  v_final <- vect(hex_final[, c("BGC", "geom")])
  v_diss  <- aggregate(v_final, "BGC")
  t3      <- st_as_sf(v_diss)
  t3      <- st_zm(t3, drop = TRUE)
  st_precision(t3) <- 2 
   st_crs(t3) <- st_crs(5070)
  #t3 <- st_transform(t3, 5070)
  toc()

  message("Clipping dissolved map to state boundary (terra)…")
  tic()
  wna_boundary <- st_read("./inputs/spatial_files/WNA_StateProv_Boundaries.gpkg") %>%
    filter(State %in% region) %>%
    st_transform(5070) %>%
    st_buffer(0)

  vb  <- vect(wna_boundary)
  v3  <- vect(t3)

  v3  <- crop(v3, vb)
  v3  <- mask(v3, vb)

  t3  <- st_as_sf(v3)
  t3  <- st_zm(t3, drop = TRUE)
  st_crs(t3) <- st_crs(5070)
  toc()

  out_path <- paste0("./state_BGCmaps/", region, "_BGC_9Mar2026_decrumbed_5070.gpkg")
  st_write(t3, out_path, delete_dsn = TRUE)

  message("Done.")
  invisible(t3)
}
```

predict_state_hex(region = "WA")

predict_state_hex(region = "WY")

predict_state_hex(region = "NV")
toc()## takes about  1550s for WA
